supported.next: App Router; declared roots; file routes only
supported.rust: One explicit library handler and binary; no macro/call-graph inference
supported.toml: TOML 1.0 nonsecret declared inputs; typed lossless observations
supported.http: POST /api/items -> POST /items; one bounded JSON object request/response
supported.docker: Declared Linux target, final runtime stage, exact artifact/config links; image acceptance required

imageDigests: Must be resolved and recorded by actual Linux image acceptance; tags do not establish reproducible immutable images
acceptance: No full cross-stack claim until M0-M7 and X01-X20 have actual evidence
